source.label: AGBD_raw parquet shards (Hugging Face)
source.method: GEDI footprint lat/lon from the metadata columns of 60 randomly chosen parquet shards (of 2658), read by HTTP range requests

note: Points are GEDI L4A footprints (one per 25x25 px patch); 359,715 read from 60 of 2658 shards, 3,000 kept. Per README the dataset covers S2 tiles in 11 regions; n_total from the AGBD_raw dataset_info.
